# stb

Single-file libraries by Sean Barrett, from https://github.com/nothings/stb. Each file is
public domain or MIT, at your choice (the license text is at the end of each file).

| File | Version | Use |
|---|---|---|
| stb_truetype.h | v1.26 | rasterises the built-in UI font |
| stb_vorbis.c | v1.24, 9f755b604db3492df2cbeb39bf84b81e3e3932e3 (2026-11-12) | decodes Ogg Vorbis music (src/audio/vorbis_decoder.cpp, music_file.cpp) |
